Title: Q: Malkavian Derangement: Alternate Personality + Derange

Messages.Author: Petri Wessman
Messages.Body:
If a non-Malkavian is made a Malk via Derange and Malkavian
Derangement: Alternate Personality is played on that vampire, does the
MD:AP stil have an effect after the vampire moves the Derange to
someone else (and so reverts back to original clan)?

Relevant card texts:

Malkavian Derangement: Alternate Personality: "Choose a ready
Malkavian. Put this card on the vampire. Each time the Malkavian takes
an action, his or her controller flips a coin. If the result is heads,
continue with the action. If the result is tails, the action fails:
his or her controller burns 1 pool and taps the Malkavian."

Derange: "(D) Put this card on a younger vampire. The vampire with
this card is considered to be the same clan as the acting vampire. The
vampire with this card does not untap as normal. During his or her
controller's untap phase, he or she may burn 1 blood to untap. The
vampire with this card may move it to another vampire as a (D) action.
This card cannot be played on a Malkavian or Malkavian Antitribu."

//Petri

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Petri Wessman wrote:
> If a non-Malkavian is made a Malk via Derange and Malkavian
> Derangement: Alternate Personality is played on that vampire, does the
> MD:AP stil have an effect after the vampire moves the Derange to
> someone else (and so reverts back to original clan)?

Alternate Personality only affects "the Malk", by card text. If the vampire is
not "the Malk", then it has no effect.


